body.value:
routing:
    force-model-prefix: false
    cooldown:
        disable-cooling: false
    retry:
        request-retry: 2
        max-retry-credentials: 0
        max-retry-interval: 0
access:
    api-keys:
        - "e2e-client-key"
        - "e2e-client-key-2"
requests:
    passthrough-headers: false
    streaming:
        keepalive-seconds: 0
        bootstrap-retries: 0
    nonstream-keepalive-interval: 0
server:
    host: "127.0.0.1"
    port: 38922
management:
    allow-remote: false
    secret-key: "<bcrypt>"
    disable-control-panel: true
oauth:
    auth-dir: "<work>/mgmt.config.v8_api_keys_auth_index/auth"
observability:
    usage:
        usage-statistics-enabled: false
api-keys:
    gemini:
        - name: gemini-1
          base-url: "http://<mock>/gemini"
          keys:
            - api-key: "sk-gemini-1"
        - name: gemini-2
          base-url: "http://<mock>/gemini"
          keys:
            - api-key: "sk-gemini-2"
    codex: [{"name": "edge", "base-url": "https://api.openai.invalid", "keys": [{"api-key": "sk-e2e-edge"}, {"api-key": "sk-e2e-edge-2"}]}]
    claude:
        - name: claude-1
          base-url: "http://<mock>/anthropic"
          keys:
            - api-key: "sk-claude-1"
        - name: claude-2
          base-url: "http://<mock>/anthropic"
          keys:
            - api-key: "sk-claude-2"
    openai-compatibility:
        - name: "mockcompat"
          base-url: "http://<mock>/compat"
          models:
            - name: "mock-gpt-4o"
              alias: "compat-gpt-4o"
            - name: "mock-reason"
              alias: "compat-reason"
          keys:
            - api-key: "sk-compat-1"
            - api-key: "sk-compat-2"
config-version: 8
